text:
maria: FYI I'm seeing spike in NCCL allreduce timeouts on eu-west-2 prod pool since 03:00 UTC. Rate-limited counters jumped.
ajay: saw that too, looks correlated with inter-node p95 east-west latency going from 0.7ms -> 4-8ms
kevin: any packet drops on interfaces? show counters pls
maria: passing snip of log
```
[ib_dev:mlx5_0] rx_err=12 tx_err=3 rx_dropped=72
rdma: RoCEv2 frag errors: 14
```
lina: interesting — drops + fragmentation. MTU negotiation might have fallen back during kernel upgrade last week
cory: we had a config push to TORs that enforced 1500 MTU for management vlan, but data vlan should be 9000 — could be a mismatch
ajay: also noticed QoS policer on TORs hitting bursts: shaping to 1Gb/s per flow for short bursts — could trigger tail latency
maria: adding net-bot output
net-bot: link 10.0.23.0/24: PMTU 9000 -> negotiated 1500 on node gpu-43
kevin: GPU nodes that fell back are all on the newer NIC firmware 2.7.1 — known bug with jumbo frames negotiation? https://vendor.example/notes/2.7.1
lina: that vendor doc mentions RoCEv2 pmtu blackhole when ECN is enabled and switch enqueues drop during PFC storms
ajay: can someone run `ethtool -k eth0` + `ibv_devinfo -v` on gpu-43?
maria: pasted outputs
```
ethtool -k eth0
rx-checksumming: on
large_receive_offload: off
```
```
# ibv_devinfo
device: mlx5_0
max_mtu: 4096
link_layer: Ethernet
```
kevin: looks like LRO/LRO offload mismatch and max_mtu not set to 9000 at RDMA layer
cory: temporary mitigation: disable ECN on TORs for data vlan, and set MTU to 9000 on nodes + switch ports, roll in canary
lina: we should also disable per-flow policer while we validate — it's likely clipping RDMA traffic bursts
ajay: raised a playbook in runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/rdma/mtu-negotiation-debug
maria: executing canary patch to set mtu+disable-ecn on two nodes now
monitor-bot: canary metrics: allreduce latency p50 down 20%, p95 down 45% after canary
kevin: next: schedule firmware rollback on 2.7.1 NICs if vendor doesn't provide patch. Also add synthetic NCCL allreduce smoke in release gate
cory: noted. I'll open infra change for full rollback plan and link to incident
maria: thanks team :thumbsup:
